description: Telegram bot that turns a topic / script / voice note into a code-drawn video, driving the unmodified drawn-by-code engine (in core/) through OpenCode with Groq / NVIDIA models.
name: drawn-by-bot

scripts.check: for f in bot/*.mjs media/*.mjs lib/*.mjs tests/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo ALL_SYNTAX_OK
